You in Rancor Rider territory.|Griz, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jedi Code: The Way of the Force|The Way of the Force]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref>}}
'''Griz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who was the leader of the [[Rancor Riders]], a street gang that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents, traveled to Tolea Biqua to pick up some [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]]. The former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zelice Sturm]], a local criminal leader, planned to test the agents, so she manipulated the Rancor Riders into attacking them. Griz and a number of other members of the gang subsequently confronted the agents and attempted to steal the power cells, which Sturm had told the gang were experimental [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]]. However, the agents defeated Griz and the rest of the Riders.
